$comment: THE TYPED BOUNDARY between the library nudger and this mod (docs/PATTERNS.md). Keys only: ReadyMadeNudge.parse keeps a pick only when it is a key of the very menu the model was shown, so no string the model writes can reach the builder except a menu line the mod itself wrote. additionalProperties is false because one unclaimed string is all an injected instruction needs.

picks.description: Menu keys copied exactly, best first, or empty when nothing on the menu is what this wish needs. At most three for a wish, five for a search.
